fichas.h1: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion:
The Hermes Maxi is an upholstered king bed by DV Home Collection, with a super-wide headboard and vertical quilting. The multilayer structure is covered in non-deformable polyurethane foam. Made in Italy.

UPHOLSTERY AND CUSHIONS

The upholstery comes in a wide range of fabrics or leathers, so you can order this as a leather bed. Goose feather square decorative cushions (19 5/8" or 15 3/4") are available on request.

KING SIZE AND FIT

Overall dimensions are 149 5/8" W x 87 3/4" D x 63" H, for an American king mattress of 76 3/4" x 80" D. If you are comparing hermes beds, the headboard here is the super-wide one. Browse all king beds.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Part of the Italian Hermes collection, this double bed is offered with a multilayer structure covered with non-deformable polyurethane foam.

The upholstery is offered in a wide range of fabric or leather options and the large headboard features a refined vertical quilting. Also, to add more comfort, goose feather square decorative cushions (19”5/8 or 15”3/4) are available upon request.

Elegance and Glamour characterize this versatile Italian furniture piece. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Rock Coffee Table with Bronzed Brass Legs by Rugiano

A Rugiano coffee table with an irregular shaped top in Decoro decorated painted wood or marble, on two bronzed brass legs. Designed by Rugiano. Made in Italy.

WOOD OR MARBLE TOP

The top is available in Decoro decorated painted wood or in a wide range of marble options — a marble coffee table, or a painted one.

Four sizes. The smallest is 20" W x 21 5/8" D x 14 1/8" H and the widest 72 3/8" W x 27 1/2" D x 11" H; three of the four are 11" high. See all coffee tables in the category.

Designed by Rugiano. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Illan Wood Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.descripcion:
The Luceplan Illan is a laser-cut wood wall sconce by Zsuzsanna Horvath, with a die-cast aluminum body and an ultra-thin, flexible layered wood shade. The wooden shade is cut from surplus material left over from the Illan suspension lamp. Made in Italy.

LED AND DIMMING

The Illan light sends a warm glow upward from a 21W LED: 1265 lm, 2700K or 3000K, CRI 90, dimmable. UL Approved.

SIZE ON THE WALL

At 11" W x 5 1/8" D x 11" H, it fits a hallway or a bedside wall. See all wall sconces.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Illan wall lamp brings the poetic lightness and innovative spirit of Zsuzsanna Horvath’s design into a refined, space-saving format. This elegant wall light features a die-cast aluminum body housing an efficient LED source that casts a soft, warm glow upward, enriching interiors with atmospheric, eco-friendly illumination. Its distinctive shade is crafted from laser-cut, layered wood, an ultra-thin and flexible material that defines Illan’s iconic geometric silhouette. In a commitment to sustainable design, the wooden element is made from surplus material left over from producing the Illan suspension lamp, transforming production scraps into a sculptural, decorative feature.

Lightweight, contemporary, and environmentally conscious, the Illan wall lamp is a perfect choice for those seeking designer wall lighting, warm LED ambience, and Italian craftsmanship that merges technology, beauty, and sustainability. UL Approved (Product build according to the National Electrical Code’s requirements and tested by Underwriters Laboratories). Made in Italy.

Light source: LED 21W 1265lm 2700K/3000K CRI 90 Dimmable. UL Approved.

fichas.descripcion_original: Piano of extraordinary elegance that is a true masterpiece of fine craftsmanship. Every detail reveals exceptional artisanal mastery: from the harmonious structure to the rich, refined carvings that adorn the base and sides. The hand-carved decorations embody timeless artistry and lend the instrument an aura of grandeur and prestige. The surface is embellished with mother-of-pearl inlays, a noble and luminous material that reflects light in iridescent shades, creating an effect of refined sophistication. This piano is a true work of art, a symbol of an era when manual skill and aesthetic taste achieved a level of absolute perfection. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Shibari Stretch Fabric Armchair by Visionnaire
fichas.descripcion:
The Shibari is a Visionnaire armchair designed by Studiopepe, fully covered in stretch fabric. Curved tubular metal legs meet at the backrest in a fluid knot.

THE KNOT AT THE BACK

The legs are curved metal tubes that converge at the backrest, forming a knot that ties structure and shape together.

SEAT AND COMFORT

The shell is fully covered in stretch fabric, so this fabric armchair keeps one continuous line from seat to backrest. A high-density polyurethane core and a webbed seat provide the support.

It comes in one size: 23 5/8" W x 27 1/2" D x 30 3/8" H, with a regular backrest and armrests. To furnish the rest of the room, see our dining chairs and armchairs.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Shibari chair comes fully covered in stretch fabric, featuring a continuous and enveloping silhouette. The curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest, forming a fluid knot that merges structure and formal expression. The high-density polyurethane core and webbed seat ensure comfort and support, striking a balance between visual lightness and structural solidity.

Across history the knot has had many different meanings, including sacred and religious symbolism. In Egypt it represented life: the knot of Isis stood for immortality and divine love. The endless knot is one of the most ancient figures utilized in Buddhist symbolism in China and Tibet, but also in geographically distant zones, to convey a sense of infinite devotion. Tying and knotting mean joining, connecting two objects, bringing them together in harmonious progress. Since ancient times the knot has had a clear meaning of junction and commitment between two people. This meaning is immediately associated with love, precisely to emphasize the inseparable nature of a bond.

This symbol conveys meanings of eternity and faithfulness. A knot made properly will not come undone, opening and separating the two objects it holds fast. Therefore a love knot unites two people forever. It is not a noose, not a tight restraint, but an intertwined connection, representing a sense of give and take, of help in moments of need. It is a soft knot that links without duress. Extended horizontally, it reminds us of the symbol of infinity: what could be a better way to represent everlasting love?
